capabilities: render interactive chessboards from FEN and PGN code blocks
step through games with comments, variations and annotations
quiz yourself in puzzle mode and review all vault puzzles
keep and edit games in .pgn and .fen files
disambiguation: Not a chess database or game recorder; it renders boards from code blocks already in your notes and writes nothing back.
extras: Not yet listed in Community plugins; until then files must be copied from a GitHub release into .obsidian/plugins/chess-notebook/. Also warns that only one plugin can render a given code block name (chess/pgn/fen), which are off by default.
problem: Obsidian shows FEN and PGN chess content as plain code with no way to view positions, step through games or study them inside a note.
summary: Renders interactive chessboards from FEN and PGN code blocks, with puzzle, step and drill modes, inline comments, annotations and eval/clock display.
